video_title: Game 3 REACTION: Wemby Saves The Spurs’ Season With EPIC MSG Performance

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' defensive intensity and Victor Wembanyama's impact in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: The second half was a brilliant defensive half by the Spurs after they were really reeling.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: They really had Wemby needing to cover ground, needing to close out. OG had another blow-by dunk on him, and they were just picking the Spurs apart. That changed in the third quarter and it screeched to a halt in the fourth quarter. Plus the Spurs made some big shots, but the second half was a brilliant defensive half by the Spurs after they were really reeling.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: The second half was a very smart half from the Spurs because in both quarters, they got into the bonus very early and therefore they lived at the foul line.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of Jalen Brunson's playmaking on Spurs' rebounding
quotes.excerpt: They're going to get rebounds because the Knicks kept the ball on one side of the floor.
quotes.quote: What we saw tonight was they're going to get rebounds because the Knicks kept the ball on one side of the floor the whole game. I'm not sure what this new thing is. Let's get rid of it. We call it the cat scan. I don't know if we've been talking about it and praising it too much and it made everybody feel like they need to be part of the game. But throwing the ball to the middle of the floor isn't just about cat getting in rhythm. It's also about not letting the defense load up. When the ball is in Jalen Brunson's hand and it's on the left side of the floor or on the right side of the floor, especially if he uses more than three or four dribbles, it's like you watch the defense load up.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's ability to manipulate defensive assignments
quotes.excerpt: Wemby shouldn't be able to pass people off when he's on a mismatch.
quotes.quote: Wemby shouldn't be able to pass people off when he's on a mismatch. Sometimes he's matched to the corner, he needs to have the respect that, and he's able to float and pass people off so that he can get back in front of the rim and make things tight. I just didn't understand it.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' struggles against Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns completely outplayed Victor Wembanyama. And since Karl-Anthony Towns got that fourth foul, he's been completely invisible.
quotes.quote: What do we talk about the first two games? Karl-Anthony Towns completely outplayed Victor Wembanyama. And since Karl-Anthony Towns got that fourth foul in the third quarter of Game 3, he's been completely invisible. He was not involved hardly at all today. I know he added up with 10 shots, but he was not to your point in the mix in the game.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Stefan Castle's aggressive defensive approach against Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I like the way Stefan Castle attacked tonight. He kept doing that slow gather.
quotes.quote: I like the way Stefan Castle attacked tonight. He kept doing that slow gather. The reason he kept doing it was because he's not trying to side-to-side him. They're driving him straight on. So it's they got nowhere to worry about going over him so they just go right into him. Stefan Castle, anytime he could get him in the ISO, he went at him. But I like the way Stefan Castle attacked tonight. He kept doing that slow gather.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's clutch performance and veteran leadership
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox gets in the lane, gets double-teamed and hits a really tough mid-range jumper.
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox gets in the lane, gets double-teamed and hits a really tough mid-range jumper. That's why De'Aaron Fox the vet is on the team to step up and make that shot in that spot. He's a guy who's won clutch player of the year before, right? Like those two shots are the five-point difference that the Spurs had at the end.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' need for greater intensity
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns, you have to do your job. There cannot be a time where there's a guard.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns, you have to do your job. There cannot be a time where there's a guard six inches shorter than you able to keep you at the free throw line and y'all are just arm wrestling. Nothing's happening. If you arm wrestle for a second, you don't get the ball, run down to the post. You don't get it there, spin and pin. This has to be one, two.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's physical play against smaller guards
quotes.excerpt: He punished the Spurs when the Spurs put Wemby on heart by playing bully ball.
quotes.quote: He punished the Spurs when the Spurs put Wemby on heart by playing bully ball and just beating up all the smaller guards, bullying his way to the rim, getting deep position, getting on the glass, and being big. Like showing the target. He was just wrestling in the night. I didn't understand it. It was like he was leaning. I don't know if he was exhausted, but it's like you didn't do this the first two games. You were moving around.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of physical play and officiating on game flow
quotes.excerpt: This is why the league has turned the way it's turned. I've had stuff like that happen.
quotes.quote: This is why the league has turned the way it's turned. I've had stuff like that happen to me. But that's when your big man that comes off the bench has a problem with that. It's like, listen, it's a Kendrick Perkins type play. But when he checks in, you go right to the ref and you say, you clean it up or I clean it up. You saw him get hit in the face. That's our guy. You want me to hit somebody in the face? You know what I'm saying? But that's what it becomes and I don't mean to turn it into fighting or nothing like that. But I mean, your guys got to ride for you.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' offensive struggles and poor decision-making in the fourth quarter
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown, you cannot come back after four minutes of Jose Alvarado and Jordan Clarkson.
quotes.quote: Mike Brown, you cannot come back after four minutes of Jose Alvarado and Jordan Clarkson, which already was way too much, and have them out there at the start of that quarter. It's a disaster. Like you cannot he got lucky with that in Game 2, he got high in his own supply in this game, he went to it again, and that's where the game was lost. Start of that fourth quarter, they didn't score for almost four minutes.
